scientific.integrity: The two-task Nash equation is solved exactly, then the source weight-reuse mechanism is evaluated under fixed gradient directions and arbitrary positive magnitude drift. Taskwise projection signs give a necessary-and-sufficient common-descent interval.
limitations: Magnitude-only drift between refresh and reuse; angular drift is excluded.
First-order common-descent statement rather than a finite-step loss theorem.
No empirical claim against weight reuse.

title: Nash-MTL weight reuse has a sharp conflict-dependent scale-drift window
